verified_claims.claim: 多官能团化（poly-functionalized）产物相对积分峰面积占比由 35S 的 68% 降至 UBQ10 的 37% 与 NOS 的 25%；单氧化产物占比由 32% 升至 62% 与 75%
UBQ10/NOS 启动子下 T5αH 表达量约为 35S 的 75% / 63%（GFP 荧光估算）
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 4 页正文第二段
verified_claims.evidence: 原文：'resulted in 75% and 63% of the expression level observed with the 35S promoter, respectively (as estimated by GFP fluorescence)'

verified_claims.claim: 在 N. benthamiana 中 35S 启动子驱动 T5αH 异源表达产生 ≥36 个氧化产物；此前仅 3 个（taxadien-5α-ol (2)、OCT (3)、iso-OCT (4)）被结构表征，新增 4 个（5、6、7、8）；S. cerevisiae 中染色体整合 TS+T5αH 同样观察到 21 种氧化产物
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 2–3 页 Results 'Heterologous expression' 与 'Characterization of T5αH product profile' 段
verified_claims.evidence: 原文：'At least 36 oxidized products were observed by gas chromatography mass spectrometry'；'only three have been thoroughly characterized – taxadien-5α-ol (2), OCT (3) and iso-OCT (4)'；'we determine the structures of four previously uncharacterized oxidized taxadiene products'；'we observed 21 oxidized taxadienes when TS and T5αH were chromosomally integrated and co-expressed in S. cerevisiae'

verified_claims.claim: 重构得到 5α,10β-diacetoxytaxadien-13α-ol (14) 与 5α,10β-diacetoxytaxadien-13α-one (15)，收率分别为 63 μg/g DW 与 42 μg/g DW；15 由 14 经 N. benthamiana 内源酶进一步氧化而来，而非 T13αH 自身产物
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 6 页 Results 段
verified_claims.evidence: 原文：'yield 14 and 15 in 63 ug/g dry weight (DW) and 42 ug/g DW yield, respectively'；'When 14 was fed into control N. benthamiana expressing GFP, it was partially oxidized to 15 (Supplementary Fig. 10). Therefore, we concluded that 15 results from oxidation by endogenous N. benthamiana enzymes rather than oxidation by T13αH'

verified_claims.claim: T13αH 对 taxadien-5α-ol (2) 高效氧化；对 5α-acetoxytaxadiene (11) 仅为 6% 相对转化率；对 5α-acetoxytaxadien-10β-ol (12) 无活性；故 18、20 经 16 间接生成（ref 24）
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 7 页 Discussion 段
verified_claims.evidence: 原文：'recombinant T13αH oxidizes taxadien-5α-ol (2) efﬁciently, oxidizes 5α-acetoxytaxadiene (11) at 6% the conversion rate levels relative to 2, and has no activity on 5α-acetoxytaxadien-10β-ol (12). Therefore, the formations of 18 and 20 likely go through 16 instead of direct oxidation by T13αH on 11 and 12'
